children: Kyndryl agreed to sell $1.0 billion of senior notes to refinance outstanding 2026 debt and repay revolving credit balances.
Kyndryl agreed to sell $600m of 7.800% senior notes due 2029 and $400m of 7.875% senior notes due 2032.
Net proceeds will be used to repay $700m of 2.05% senior notes maturing Oct 2026 and to repay revolver balances and fees.
Both series are senior unsecured, pari passu with other senior unsecured debt and are not guaranteed by subsidiaries.
Notes include customary covenants, change-of-control repurchase rights and call provisions including make-whole before par call dates.
